title: Device job log batch
description: Request body for POST /api/device/jobs/{id}/logs (agent protocol, X-Bifrost-Key device auth, claim_token fencing). The required claim_token is the UUID returned by the claim response; a stale or wrong token fails with fence_violation. Idempotency key is the pair (path job id, entry.seq). Frozen for epic #818 / M0.2 #828.

claim_token.description: Fencing token from the claim response for this job; rotated on every (re)claim.

entries.description: Log entries in ascending seq order within a batch. Batch request body cap: 1 MiB. Agents normally flush around every 500 ms or 32 KiB of output.

seq.description: Monotonic per-job sequence number assigned by the claiming agent starting at 1. Server accepts the first write for each seq; an identical replay of the same (job, seq, stream, text) is a no-op success; a different body for an already-accepted seq fails with HTTP 409 log_seq_conflict.

stream.description: Source stream of the captured output.

text.description: Captured output chunk. Cap is 64 KiB of UTF-8 bytes per entry; this maxLength bounds characters only and the server enforces the byte cap (payload_too_large).

ts.description: Agent-side capture time (advisory; server also records receive time).
